title: Rory and the Moonlit Lagoon
verses:
The sun drifted down as the shadows grew long,
And evening began with a cricket's soft song.
Rory walked down to the edge of the lake,
Where ripples were silent and barely awake.

Nia flew high in the darkening sky,
To watch as the fluffy gray clouds drifted by.
Benny stepped into the water so deep,
And whispered, "The lake is preparing for sleep."

Ricky ran up with a bounce and a grin,
Then folded his legs as he tucked his chin in.
Psittaco snuggled in moss soft and green,
The coziest nest that he ever had seen.

Tilly sat down on the cool sandy shore,
And said she would travel the forest no more.
The stars started blinking above in a row,
As night brought a soothing and peaceful warm glow.

Rory gave everyone kisses goodnight,
As darkness replaced the last bits of the light.
They listened together to waves on the sand,
While slumber swept softly across the whole land.

The mist wrapped around them to keep them all warm,
Safe from the soft breeze and away from a storm.
Rory closed eyes as the world fell asleep,
And tucked in his tail for a beautiful sleep.
